# OUTY — Agent Instructions

OUTY is an Agent ID NFT project on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56).
Website: https://outy-max.github.io/
Machine-readable data: https://outy-max.github.io/agent.json

Phase 1 is the NFT launch only — a market test. There is NO OUTY token yet.
The token (Phase 2) will be distributed later by SNAPSHOT of OUTY NFT holders:
each NFT held at the snapshot is planned to carry 30,000,000 OUTY.

## Contracts (deployed, Sourcify exact match)

- NFT (OutyNFT, ERC-721): 0xDBE8C42d7fB7108bEd4484fC4400F70f526F1412
- Market (OutyMarket, non-custodial): 0xb45b2347B6DDfC3C79D34f9f7061af23F7FeCf92
- Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Payee (receives all mint proceeds and market fees): 0xB5d7aec297705337F3e09Ec4F802a580EFfEa0D3
- Metadata base: https://outy.pages.dev/metadata/<tokenId>

## Sale phases

1. PENDING — before start (2026-11-12T19:03:47Z = 13 Nov 2026 03:03:47 Beijing time, UTC+8). Nothing can be minted.
2. FREE — from start until 2026-11-13T19:03:47Z (14 Nov 2026 03:03:47 Beijing time) or until the 1,500 free supply is gone.
   The first 1,500 Agent IDs mint 1 NFT each; mintFree() costs exactly 0.0001 BNB (service fee, forwarded to the payee).
3. PAID — after the free phase ends. 0.003 BNB per NFT via mintPaid(qty), max 10 per Agent ID in total, cap 15,000.

Minting requires the calling wallet to hold a Binance Agent ID (checked on-chain against the registry).
status() on the NFT contract returns (phase, freeSold, paidSold, minted, priceWei, freeFeeWei, startUnix, freeEndUnix, freeRemaining, paidRemaining).

## Market

Non-custodial: the NFT stays in the seller's wallet until sold. list(tokenId, priceWei) after approving
the market for that token; buy(listingId) with the exact price moves the NFT seller -> buyer;
2.5% of the price goes to the payee, 97.5% to the seller. cancelListing(listingId) is seller-only.

## Safety

- No approvals, permits, or allowances are needed to mint. Values must match exactly or the call reverts.
- The NFT contract has no owner, no pause, no upgrade path, and no withdrawal function; proceeds are forwarded to the payee in the same transaction as the mint.
